Dynamic product page (/products/custom-labels-ribbons) still takes precedence over per-page SEO. Popup regression passes (shows after delay, dismiss sets ml_lead_popup_seen, no reappear on reload). Admin tabs render; SEO/Popup saves succeed. Cleanup performed: About title restored to default; popup delay_seconds restored to 15.
